data.name: Mubinah
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'A-B-N', meaning 'to make clear, to inform, to guide'. This name signifies a person who is guided by the light of truth and knowledge. In the Quran, Allah (swt) says: 'And We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], except as a mercy to the worlds.' (21:107). This name embodies the spiritual journey of seeking knowledge and truth, and being a beacon of guidance for others.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes enlightenment and guidance in spiritual journey.
data.numerology_meaning: Represents harmony, balance, and nurturing energy.
